raw_signature: sprite.*(not moving|won'?t move|stays in the same place)|move \d+ steps.*nothing
plain_translation: The sprite has a move block, but nothing is telling it when to run. It needs a start event and a loop.
checklist_fixes: Make sure you have a when green flag clicked block on top.
Wrap your move block inside a forever loop , otherwise it only runs once.
Check the sprite actually has that script , click the sprite thumbnail in the sprite list.
Verify the sprite isn't hidden (use show block).
problem_html: You added a "move 10 steps" block but nothing happens when you click the green flag. The sprite stays in the same place.
prevention_html: Always start with the when green flag clicked block. If you want continuous movement, always wrap actions in forever.
keywords: sprite not moving movement block when green flag clicked forever

plain_translation: The costume name in your block does not match a costume on the sprite. Spelling and spaces matter.
checklist_fixes: Check the costume name matches exactly , spelling and spaces matter.
Go to the Costumes tab and verify you actually created the costumes.
Make sure you're targeting the right sprite , costumes are per-sprite.
If using "next costume", the sprite cycles through existing costumes.
problem_html: You added "switch costume to..." but the sprite's appearance doesn't change visually.
prevention_html: Name your costumes clearly (e.g. "idle", "run1", "run2") so you can reference them in code without typos.
keywords: costume not changing switch backdrop visual appear

raw_signature: variable.*(not updating|stays at|same number)|score.*(stays at 0|not updating)
plain_translation: The score is being set back to zero, or the sprite changing it is not the one showing it.
checklist_fixes: Make sure you created the variable first (Variables → Make a Variable).
Use "change [score] by 1" , not "set score to 0" , when incrementing.
Check the "for all sprites" vs "for this sprite" scope , is the right sprite reading it?
Verify the "if touching [player]" condition actually triggers.
problem_html: Your score variable stays at 0 even though you're collecting items. The variable reporter on stage shows the same number.
prevention_html: Add the variable reporter to the stage so you can watch it update in real-time. Use "for all sprites" for shared scores.
keywords: variable not updating score counter set change

plain_translation: A clone needs its own start block and a delete block, or it keeps piling up and doing the same thing.
checklist_fixes: Clones need when I start as a clone to know what to do.
Use delete this clone at the end of the clone script or it'll pile up.
The original sprite (before cloning) can't use "delete this clone" , only clones can.
Don't use forever without a wait inside clone scripts , it'll freeze Scratch.
problem_html: Clones aren't appearing, or they're all doing the same thing, or they won't go away.
prevention_html: Limit clones with a "if number of clones < 50 then" check. Too many clones slow everything down.
keywords: clone issues duplicates create delete myself clones not working
